seo.title: Contact RankStruct | SEO, Web Development & Automation
seo.description: Tell us what you're working on. RankStruct works remotely with businesses worldwide on SEO, web development and automation. We reply within 24 hours.

hero.title: Tell us what you're working on.
paragraphs: Whether it's search visibility, your website, a workflow that takes too much time, or something you can't quite name yet, start by telling us about it.
We'll review it and reply with an honest take on what makes sense, what it may involve and whether we're the right fit.

form.title: Start a project
form.privacy: We'll only use your details to reply to your message.

next.title: What happens next
next.text: Every project follows four predictable, transparent milestones before any monetary commitment.

steps.title: We review your message
steps.text: We look at what you've shared and, if you included it, your current website or setup.

steps.title: We reply within 24 hours
steps.text: You'll get a response on business days, either with initial thoughts or a few questions to understand things better.

steps.title: We talk it through
steps.text: If it makes sense, we'll set up a short call to understand the details.

steps.title: You get a clear proposal
steps.text: Scope, timeline and price, all in writing, before any work begins.

next.note: No pressure and no obligation. If what you need isn't something we can help with, we'll tell you.

location.title: Remote-first. Working with businesses everywhere.
location.text: RankStruct operates fully remotely, so location isn't a barrier. We work with clients across different countries and time zones, using video calls, email, shared documents and project tools to keep everything clear and on track.

faq.title: Before you reach out
faq.text: Common queries answered frankly before we jump into an initial dialogue.

items.question: Do you work with businesses outside my country?
items.answer: Yes. RankStruct works remotely with businesses worldwide. Calls are scheduled at times that work for both sides.

items.question: What if I don't know exactly what I need?
items.answer: That's fine. Tell us what's happening and what you'd like to improve. Working out the right solution is part of what we do.

items.question: Is there a minimum project size?
items.answer: Projects are scoped around your needs, so there's no fixed package. If a project is too small to be worth it for you, we'll say so honestly.

items.question: Is the first conversation free?
items.answer: Yes. The first review and call are free, with no obligation.

items.question: Can you sign an NDA?
items.answer: Yes. If your project involves sensitive information, we're happy to sign an NDA before discussing details.
